title: 5 Stars!
text: This was a magical day along the gorgeous Spanish coastline with a Michelin rated lunch seaside! I cannot rave enough about MoBuSca our tour guide!
author: objenmd

title: Great tour!
text: We had such a wonderful time visiting the Costa Brava. Our guide was amazing! She was knowledgeable, personable, and willing to tailor the experience to our wants.
author: David_C

title: Sue Brandell
text: A great way to see the outer areas of Barcelona- ancient seaside towns and quaint cafes and restaurants. Monia was an amazing guide, enriching our ride with history and tales of Dali and friends and visiting a fabulous restaurant where he worked and played. The blue water views were spectacular
author: Susanne_B

title: La Coasta Brava Day Tour
text: Absolutely a wonderful day touring the countryside of Las Costas Brava.  Monia's personal knowledge of the region made our day very enjoyable. Her recommendations for the best views and restaurants are unsurpassed.
author: Mary_S

title: Phenomenal Experience
text: Monia is awesome! She knew Costa Brava really well and even booked us a reservation at a great restaurant right next to the coast. Highly recommend using her with any exploration of the area!
author: Alex_G

title: Monia, the guide, is...
text: Monia, the guide, is excellent. Great attitude and explains everything in detail. You know beautiful places with her and you eat very rich. Highly recommended!
author: Pablo_A

title: Excellent tour
text: Monia was our guide for the day and she was truly amazing. The drive to Costa Brava and tour was exceptional, very flexible (appreciate this!) and for that she deserves a special thanks. Monia is such a warm personality and highly motivated guide. She is very knowledgeable of the area. I highly recommend Monia! She is friendly, funny and creates a wonderful atmosphere.
author: Raylette_M

title: Amazing day in tossa de mar
text: Monia was an amazing guide. She tailored the entire fay to accommodate our toddler, showed us all the amazing sights of tossa de mar and allowed for plenty of rest and relaxation swimming in one of the most beautiful coves of tossa. Highly recommend!
author: Vamsee_L

title: Wonderful private tour of Costa Brava history and beaches
text: The day we spent exploring Costa Brava with Monia was wonderful. Because she grew up in the area, she was able to share with us some of her favorite places, which we also loved. Especially the local shops in the village of Pals and the wonderful restaurant on the beach in Tamariu. She also shared a lot of knowledge about the history and people of the area. It was a great, relaxing way to see the area.
author: Diane_J

title: Fantastic
text: I truly didn’t know what to expect but this tour was great. We visited many small medieval and beach towns and a winery. Monia had a great knowledge of the area and has a great personality. She made us feel like family and showed us so many beautiful places. We ate at a marvelous restaurant (Restaurant Llfranc) we all had a seafood paella and local wine from a nearby winery. The food , wine, service was delightful and sitting on the water witha fantastic view, great people ,good conversation , food  and wine. What more can you ask for?
